title: Wall Mount Shower Curtain Brackets And Rod For 1-Inch Shower Rod (Pair) | Flat Troll Blue | Solid Brass | Prestige Regal Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom with wall mount shower curtain brackets and rod supports designed to fit any 1-inch diameter shower rod, with concealed mounting for a clean finished look in Flat Troll Blue, which presents a distinctive, muted blue-gray tone that adds artistic character to contemporary bathroom designs.

  • Flat Troll Blue creates a distinctive focal point
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Pair included: Sold as a pair; shower rod sold separately
  • Clean installation: Concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Coordinated style: Designed to complement the Prestige Regal Collection and transitional bathroom hardware

Specs

  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Material: Brass
  • Dimensions (each): 3 in L x 3 in W x 2.25 in H
  • Projection: 2 in
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Product weight: 1.6 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Shower curtain rod brackets and installation hardware (shower rod sold separately)
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
